name: TLS service negotiates legacy TLSv1.0
description: The TLS endpoint completes a handshake using TLSv1.0. RFC 8996 deprecates TLSv1.0 and TLSv1.1 because they lack modern AEAD ciphers and key-derivation functions, and PCI-DSS 3.2.1 requires their disablement on payment-card endpoints. A host that still negotiates TLSv1.0 will not pass current compliance audits.
